reason: CloserAI is a desktop AI workbench that hosts an agent runtime and orchestrates permission-isolated chat, document-work, and coding workflows with configurable model providers.

summaries.zh: CloserAI 是一个桌面端 AI 工作台，用于运行智能体并协调聊天、文档处理和代码工作流。
summaries.en: CloserAI is a desktop AI workbench for running an agent and coordinating chat, document-processing, and coding workflows.

capabilities: Hosts an AI agent runtime for chat, work, and code workflows
Supports web search and read-only attachments in Chat mode
Processes documents in an application-private sandbox in Work mode
Accesses an approved directory and can use shell, git, and terminal with approval prompts in Code mode
Connects to DeepSeek, OpenAI-compatible, or mock model providers
Persists local sessions, projects, history, and imports or exports
Provides desktop tray controls, notifications, and launch-at-login
